CREATE TABLE [tab_calculation_method_parameter_rates](
  [parameter_id] bigint PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text REFERENCES [tab_parameters]([parameter_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [calculation_method] text, 
  [formula_rate] text, 
  [min_value] double, 
  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [max_value] double, 
  [max_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [group_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_groups]([group_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [can_be_varied] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [can_be_varied_in_population] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [read_only] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [sequence] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [visible] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_calculation_method_rates](
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_calculation_methods]([calculation_method]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_rates]([formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [formula] text, 
  [dimension] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_dimensions]([dimension]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]));

CREATE TABLE [tab_containers](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parent_container_id] bigint, 
  [parent_container_type] text REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [parent_container_name] text, 
  [visible] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [is_logical] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([parent_container_id], [parent_container_type], [parent_container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_molecules](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_molecules]([molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [visible] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_molecule_start_formulas](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [value_origin] bigint REFERENCES [tab_value_origins]([id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) REFERENCES [tab_container_molecules]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameters](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_parameters]([parameter_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [can_be_varied] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [read_only] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [visible] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [can_be_varied_in_population] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [group_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_groups]([group_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [sequence] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [build_mode] text DEFAULT 'LOCAL', 
  [building_block_type] text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SIMULATION', 
  [is_input] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_changed_by_create_individual bigint default 0, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameter_curves](
  [parameter_value_version] text NOT NULL, 
  [species] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [population] text NOT NULL, 
  [gender] text NOT NULL, 
  [age] double NOT NULL, 
  [gestational_age] double NOT NULL DEFAULT 40, 
  [distribution_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_distribution_types]([distribution_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [mean_value] double NOT NULL, 
  [standard_deviation] double NOT NULL, 
  [min_value] double, 
  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [max_value] double, 
  [max_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [value_origin] bigint REFERENCES [tab_value_origins]([id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([parameter_value_version], [species], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [population], [gender], [age], [gestational_age]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([population], [gender]) REFERENCES [tab_population_genders]([population], [gender]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([species], [parameter_value_version]) REFERENCES [tab_species_parameter_value_versions]([species], [parameter_value_version]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameters]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameter_fcurves](
  [species] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_species]([species]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [population] text NOT NULL, 
  [gender] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [distribution_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_distribution_types]([distribution_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [mean_value_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [standard_deviation_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [min_value] double, 
  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [max_value] double, 
  [max_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [value_origin] bigint REFERENCES [tab_value_origins]([id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([species], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [population], [gender]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([population], [gender]) REFERENCES [tab_population_genders]([population], [gender]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameters]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [mean_value_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [standard_deviation_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameter_rates](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [min_value] double, 
  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [max_value] double, 
  [max_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [value_origin] bigint REFERENCES [tab_value_origins]([id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameters]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameter_rhs](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [calculation_method]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameter_rates]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name], [calculation_method]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_parameter_values](
  [parameter_value_version] text NOT NULL, 
  [species] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [default_value] double NOT NULL, 
  [min_value] double, 
  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [max_value] double, 
  [max_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  [value_origin] bigint REFERENCES [tab_value_origins]([id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([parameter_value_version], [species], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([species], [parameter_value_version]) REFERENCES [tab_species_parameter_value_versions]([species], [parameter_value_version]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameters]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_container_rates](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [calculation_method], [formula_rate]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE [tab_container_tags](
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [tag] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_tags]([tag]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [tag]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_formulation_routes](
  [formulation] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [route] text NOT NULL, 
  [sequence] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([formulation], [container_type], [route]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_type], [formulation]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

  [is_advanced] bigint DEFAULT 0,

  [full_name] text NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE [tab_model_containers](
  [model] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_models]([model]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [usage_in_individual] text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REQUIRED', 
  PRIMARY KEY([model], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_model_container_molecules](
  [model] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL, 
  [negative_values_allowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [is_present] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([model], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) REFERENCES [tab_container_molecules]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([model], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_model_containers]([model], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_molecules](
  [molecule] text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, 
  [display_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [description] text NOT NULL, 
  [sequence] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [icon_name] text, 
  [default_is_present] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  [start_formula_calculation_method] text, 
  [start_formula_rate] text, 
  [is_floating] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  [molecule_type] text, 
  FOREIGN KEY([start_formula_calculation_method], [start_formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

  [min_isallowed] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

  [first_neighbor_id] bigint,

  [first_neighbor_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [second_neighbor_id] bigint, 
  [second_neighbor_type] text NOT NULL,

  FOREIGN KEY([second_neighbor_id], [second_neighbor_type], [second_neighbor_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([neighborhood_id], [neighborhood_type], [neighborhood_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_observers](
  [observer] text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, 
  [description] text, 
  [display_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [observer_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [sequence] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [category] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_categories]([category]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [icon_name] text, 
  [builder_type] text DEFAULT 'CONTAINER', 
  [is_for_all_molecules] bigint DEFAULT 0, 
  [dimension] text REFERENCES [tab_dimensions]([dimension]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_ontogenies](
  [molecule] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_protein_names]([protein]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [species] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_species]([species]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [group_name] text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ONTOGENY_LIVER_ALL' REFERENCES [tab_groups]([group_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [postmenstrual_age] double NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [ontogeny_factor] double DEFAULT 0, 
  [deviation] double DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([molecule], [species], [group_name], [postmenstrual_age]));

CREATE TABLE [tab_processes](
  [process] text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROCESS', 
  [template] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [group_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_groups]([group_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [kinetic_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_kinetic_types]([kinetic_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [process_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_process_types]([process_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [action_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [create_process_rate_parameter] bigint DEFAULT 0, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_type], [process]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_process_descriptor_conditions](
  [process] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_processes]([process]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [tag] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_tags]([tag]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [tag_type] text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SOURCE', 
  [should_have] bigint DEFAULT 1, comment text, 
  PRIMARY KEY([process], [tag], [tag_type]));

  [stoichiometry] double NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

CREATE TABLE [tab_rate_container_molecules](
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL, 
  [alias] text NOT NULL, 
  [use_amount] bigint DEFAULT 0, 
  PRIMARY KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) REFERENCES [tab_container_molecules]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE [tab_rate_container_parameters](
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_container_types]([container_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [alias] text NOT NULL, 
  PRIMARY KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_parameters]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [parameter_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_rate_generic_molecules](
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [path_id] bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_object_paths]([path_id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_molecules]([molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [alias] text NOT NULL, 
  [use_amount] bigint DEFAULT 0, 
  PRIMARY KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate], [path_id], [molecule]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_rate_generic_parameters](
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [path_id] bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_object_paths]([path_id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_parameters]([parameter_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [alias] text NOT NULL, 
  PRIMARY KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate], [path_id], [parameter_name]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

  [species] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_species]([species]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_calculation_methods]([calculation_method]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  PRIMARY KEY([species], [calculation_method]));

CREATE TABLE [tab_transports](
  [transport_direction] text REFERENCES [tab_transport_directions]([transport_direction]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [process] text REFERENCES [tab_processes]([process]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [source_organ] text, 
  [source_compartment] text, 
  [target_organ] text, 
  [target_compartment] text, 
  [source_organ_type] text, 
  [source_compartment_type] text, 
  [target_organ_type] text, 
  [target_compartment_type] text, 
  CONSTRAINT [tab_transports_pk] PRIMARY KEY([transport_direction], [process], [source_organ], [source_compartment], [target_organ], [target_compartment], [source_organ_type], [source_compartment_type], [target_organ_type], [target_compartment_type]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([source_organ_type], [source_organ]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([source_compartment_type], [source_compartment]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([target_organ_type], [target_organ]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([target_compartment_type], [target_compartment]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE tab_population_disease_states
(
    population    text not null
        constraint tab_population_disease_states_tab_populations_population_fk
            references tab_populations
            on update cascade,
    disease_state text not null
        constraint tab_population_disease_states_tab_disease_states_disease_state_fk
            references tab_disease_states
            on update cascade,
    constraint tab_population_disease_states_pk
        primary key (population, disease_state)
);

CREATE TABLE [tab_event_changed_generic_parameters](
  [event_id] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [event_container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [event_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [path_id] bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_object_paths]([path_id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [parameter_name] text NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_parameters]([parameter_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [use_as_value] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [path_id], [parameter_name], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) REFERENCES [tab_event_conditions]([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_event_conditions](
  [event_id] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [event_container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [event_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [is_one_time] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name]) REFERENCES [tab_containers]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE [tab_known_transporters_containers](
  [gene] text, 
  [species] text, 
  [container_type] text, 
  [container_name] text, 
  [transport_type] text REFERENCES [tab_active_transport_types]([transport_type]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [membrane] text, 
  CONSTRAINT [tab_known_transporters_containers_pk] PRIMARY KEY([gene], [species], [container_type], [container_name]), 
  CONSTRAINT [tab_known_transporters_containers_tab_known_transporters_gene_species_fk] FOREIGN KEY([gene], [species]) REFERENCES [tab_known_transporters]([gene], [species]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_type], [container_name]) REFERENCES [tab_container_names]([container_type], [container_name]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  CHECK(membrane IN ('Apical', 'Basolateral', 'BloodBrainBarrier', 'Tissue')));

CREATE TABLE [tab_event_changed_container_molecules](
  [event_id] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [event_container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [event_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_id] bigint NOT NULL, 
  [container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [container_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [use_as_value] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) REFERENCES [tab_container_molecules]([container_id], [container_type], [container_name], [molecule]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) REFERENCES [tab_event_conditions]([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE [tab_event_changed_generic_molecules](
  [event_id] bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
  [event_container_type] text NOT NULL, 
  [event_name] text NOT NULL, 
  [path_id] bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES [tab_object_paths]([path_id]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  [molecule] text NOT NULL, 
  [calculation_method] text NOT NULL, 
  [formula_rate] text NOT NULL, 
  [use_as_value] bigint DEFAULT 1, 
  PRIMARY KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [path_id], [molecule], [calculation_method]), 
  FOREIGN KEY([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) REFERENCES [tab_calculation_method_rates]([calculation_method], [formula_rate]) ON UPDATE CASCADE, 
  FOREIGN KEY([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) REFERENCES [tab_event_conditions]([event_id], [event_container_type], [event_name], [calculation_method]) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE);

CREATE VIEW VIEW_APPLICATION_PROCESSES AS SELECT TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_NAME AS Application, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME AS Process
FROM TAB_CONTAINERS
WHERE (((TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_TYPE)='APPLICATION') AND ((TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE)='PROCESS'));
CREATE VIEW VIEW_APPLICATIONS AS SELECT TAB_APPLICATIONS.APPLICATION_NAME AS Name, TAB_APPLICATIONS.APPLICATION_TYPE AS ApplicationType, TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES.IS_FORMULATION_REQUIRED AS IsFormulationRequired
FROM TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES INNER JOIN TAB_APPLICATIONS ON TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES.APPLICATION_TYPE = TAB_APPLICATIONS.APPLICATION_TYPE;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CALCULATION_METHOD_PARAMETER_DESCRIPTOR_CONDITIONS AS SELECT TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_PARAMETER_DESCR_CONDITIONS.PARAMETER_ID AS ParameterId, TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_PARAMETER_DESCR_CONDITIONS.TAG AS Tag, TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_PARAMETER_DESCR_CONDITIONS.SHOULD_HAVE AS ShouldHave
FROM TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_PARAMETER_DESCR_CONDITIONS;
CREATE VIEW OutputCalcMethodForBBParameters AS SELECT DISTINCT TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.PARAMETER_NAME
FROM TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES
WHERE (((TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CALCULATION_METHOD)='BlackBox_CalculationMethod'));
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATE_FORMULA AS     SELECT TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod, TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.FORMULA_RATE AS Rate, TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.FORMULA AS Formula, TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.DIMENSION AS Dimension
FROM TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CALCULATION_METHODS AS SELECT TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS.CALCULATION_METHOD AS Id, TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS.CATEGORY AS Category, TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS.SEQUENCE AS Sequence
FROM TAB_CATEGORIES INNER JOIN TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS ON TAB_CATEGORIES.CATEGORY = TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS.CATEGORY
WHERE (((TAB_CALCULATION_METHODS.CALCULATION_METHOD)<>'SurfaceAreaPlsInt_VAR2'));
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CATEGORIES AS SELECT TAB_CATEGORIES.CATEGORY AS Name, TAB_CATEGORIES.CATEGORY_TYPE AS CategoryType
FROM TAB_CATEGORIES;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING AS SELECT TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.PROCESS_CONTAINER_ID AS ProcessId, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.PROCESS_NAME AS ProcessName, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.PROCESS_PARAMETER_NAME AS ParameterName, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.CONTAINER_ID AS ContainerId, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.CONTAINER_TYPE AS ContainerType, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.CONTAINER_NAME AS ContainerName, TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING.PARAMETER_NAME AS ContainerParameterName
FROM TAB_COMPOUND_PROCESS_PARAMETER_MAPPING;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CONTAINER_TAGS AS SELECT TAB_CONTAINER_TAGS.CONTAINER_ID AS Id, TAB_CONTAINER_TAGS.CONTAINER_TYPE AS Type, TAB_CONTAINER_TAGS.CONTAINER_NAME AS Name, TAB_CONTAINER_TAGS.TAG AS Tag
FROM TAB_CONTAINER_TAGS;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_CONTAINERS AS SELECT TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_ID AS Id, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE AS Type, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME AS Name, TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_ID AS ParentId, TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_TYPE AS ParentType, TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_NAME AS ParentName, TAB_CONTAINERS.VISIBLE AS Visible, TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES.EXTENSION AS Extension, TAB_CONTAINERS.IS_LOGICAL AS IsLogical
FROM TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES INNER JOIN TAB_CONTAINERS ON (TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME) AND (TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE);

FROM TAB_GROUPS;

FROM TAB_MODEL_OBSERVERS
ORDER BY TAB_MODEL_OBSERVERS.MODEL, TAB_MODEL_OBSERVERS.OBSERVER;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_MODEL_PROCESSES AS SELECT TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS.MODEL AS Model, TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME AS Process
FROM TAB_CONTAINERS INNER JOIN TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS ON (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME) AND (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE) AND (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_ID = TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_ID)

CREATE VIEW VIEW_MODEL_SPECIES AS SELECT TAB_MODEL_SPECIES.MODEL AS Model, TAB_MODEL_SPECIES.SPECIES AS Species, TAB_MODEL_SPECIES.IS_DEFAULT AS IsDefault

FROM TAB_MODELS

FROM TAB_ORGAN_TYPES;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS AS SELECT TAB_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSION AS Id, TAB_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.CATEGORY AS Category, TAB_SPECIES_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.SPECIES AS Species
FROM TAB_CATEGORIES INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS INNER JOIN TAB_SPECIES_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS ON TAB_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSION = TAB_SPECIES_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSION) ON TAB_CATEGORIES.CATEGORY = TAB_PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSIONS.CATEGORY;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_POPULATION_AGE AS SELECT TAB_POPULATION_AGE.POPULATION AS Population, TAB_POPULATION_AGE.DEFAULT_AGE AS DefaultAge, TAB_POPULATION_AGE.MIN_AGE AS MinAge, TAB_POPULATION_AGE.MAX_AGE AS MaxAge, TAB_POPULATION_AGE.DEFAULT_AGE_UNIT AS DefaultAgeUnit

FROM (TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES INNER JOIN TAB_PROCESSES ON (TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_PROCESSES.PROCESS) AND (TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_PROCESSES.CONTAINER_TYPE)) INNER JOIN TAB_PROCESS_RATES ON TAB_PROCESSES.PROCESS = TAB_PROCESS_RATES.PROCESS

CREATE VIEW RateParametersAbsolutePath AS SELECT TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.FORMULA_RATE AS Rate, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_ID AS ContainerId, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE AS ContainerType, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_NAME AS ContainerName, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME AS RateObjectName, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.ALIAS AS Alias, 0 AS RelativeObjectPathId, 1 AS IsAbsolutePath, 0 AS UseAmount, TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION AS Dimension
FROM TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_PARAMETERS ON TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME
WHERE (((TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE)<>'LINK' And (TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE)<>'APPLICATION'));
CREATE VIEW RateParametersRelativePath AS SELECT TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.FORMULA_RATE AS Rate, 0 AS ContainerId, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.REF_CONTAINER_TYPE AS ContainerType, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.REF_CONTAINER_NAME AS ContainerName, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME AS RateObjectName, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.ALIAS AS Alias, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.PATH_ID AS RelativeObjectPathId, 0 AS IsAbsolutePath, 0 AS UseAmount, TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION AS Dimension
FROM TAB_OBJECT_PATHS INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS ON TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME) ON TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.PATH_ID = TAB_RATE_GENERIC_PARAMETERS.PATH_ID;
CREATE VIEW RateMoleculesAbsolutePath AS SELECT TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.FORMULA_RATE AS Rate, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CONTAINER_ID AS ContainerId, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CONTAINER_TYPE AS ContainerType, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CONTAINER_NAME AS ContainerName, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.MOLECULE AS RateObjectName, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.ALIAS AS Alias, 0 AS RelativeObjectPathId, 1 AS IsAbsolutePath, TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.USE_AMOUNT AS UseAmount, case when [USE_AMOUNT]=1 then 'Amount' else 'Concentration (molar)' end  AS Dimension
FROM TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES
WHERE (((TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CONTAINER_TYPE)<>'LINK' And (TAB_RATE_CONTAINER_MOLECULES.CONTAINER_TYPE)<>'APPLICATION'));
CREATE VIEW RateMoleculesRelativePath AS SELECT TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.FORMULA_RATE AS Rate, 0 AS ContainerId, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.REF_CONTAINER_TYPE, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.REF_CONTAINER_NAME, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.MOLECULE AS RateObjectName, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.ALIAS AS Alias, TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.PATH_ID AS RelativeObjectPathId, 0 AS IsAbsolutePath, TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.USE_AMOUNT AS UseAmount, case when [USE_AMOUNT]=1 then 'Amount' else 'Concentration (molar)' end AS Dimension
FROM TAB_OBJECT_PATHS INNER JOIN TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES ON TAB_OBJECT_PATHS.PATH_ID = TAB_RATE_GENERIC_MOLECULES.PATH_ID;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_RATE_OBJECT_PATHS AS SELECT * FROM RateParametersAbsolutePath

UNION SELECT * FROM RateMoleculesAbsolutePath

UNION SELECT * FROM RateParametersRelativePath

UNION SELECT * FROM RateMoleculesRelativePath;

CREATE VIEW VIEW_POPULATION_DISEASE_STATES as
SELECT tab_population_disease_states.disease_state AS DiseaseState, tab_population_disease_states.population AS Population
FROM tab_population_disease_states;
CREATE VIEW Repr_DiseaseStates as
SELECT 'DISEASE_STATE' AS ObjectType,
       tab_disease_states.disease_state AS Name, 
       tab_disease_states.display_name AS DisplayName, 
       tab_disease_states.description AS Description, 
       '' AS IconName, 
       '' AS SubType
FROM tab_disease_states
ORDER BY tab_disease_states.display_name;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_REPRESENTATION_DATA AS
SELECT * FROM Repr_Parameters
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_CalcMethods
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Categories
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Containers
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Groups
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Genders
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_DistrTypes
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Models
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Molecules
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Observers
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Populations
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Processes
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_PVV
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_Species
UNION ALL 
SELECT* FROM Repr_KineticTypes
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_ProcessTypes
UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM Repr_TransportDirections
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM Repr_DiseaseStates
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM Repr_Info;

CREATE VIEW VIEW_PARAMETER_RATES AS
SELECT TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_ID               AS ContainerId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_TYPE             AS ContainerType,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_NAME             AS ContainerName,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME                            AS ParameterName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CALCULATION_METHOD         AS CalculationMethod,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.FORMULA_RATE               AS Rate,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.MIN_VALUE                  AS MinValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.MIN_ISALLOWED              AS MinIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.MAX_VALUE                  AS MaxValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.MAX_ISALLOWED              AS MaxIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.READ_ONLY                       AS ReadOnly,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED                   AS CanBeVaried,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED_IN_POPULATION     AS CanBeVariedInPopulation,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.VISIBLE                         AS Visible,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.GROUP_NAME                      AS GroupName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILDING_BLOCK_TYPE             AS BuildingBlockType,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION                                 AS Dimension,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILD_MODE                      AS BuildMode,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE                        AS Sequence,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DEFAULT_UNIT                              AS DefaultUnit,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.VALUE_ORIGIN               AS ValueOriginId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.IS_INPUT                        AS IsInput,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.is_changed_by_create_individual AS IsChangedByCreateIndividual

FROM TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES
         INNER JOIN (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES ON
        TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.PARAMETER_NAME) ON
        (TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_NAME) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_TYPE) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_ID = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CONTAINER_ID))
                    ON (TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.FORMULA_RATE = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.FORMULA_RATE) AND
                       (TAB_CALCULATION_METHOD_RATES.CALCULATION_METHOD =
                        TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RATES.CALCULATION_METHOD)
ORDER BY TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_PARAMETER_RHS AS
SELECT TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.CONTAINER_ID       AS Id,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.CONTAINER_TYPE     AS Type,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.CONTAINER_NAME     AS Name,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.PARAMETER_NAME     AS ParameterName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.CALCULATION_METHOD AS CalculationMethod,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS.FORMULA_RATE       AS Rate
FROM TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_RHS;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_PARAMETER_VALUES AS
SELECT TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_ID                    AS ContainerId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE                  AS ContainerType,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_NAME                  AS ContainerName,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME                            AS ParameterName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.MIN_VALUE                 AS MinValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.MIN_ISALLOWED             AS MinIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.MAX_VALUE                 AS MaxValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.MAX_ISALLOWED             AS MaxIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.READ_ONLY                       AS ReadOnly,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED                   AS CanBeVaried,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED_IN_POPULATION     AS CanBeVariedInPopulation,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.VISIBLE                         AS Visible,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.GROUP_NAME                      AS GroupName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILDING_BLOCK_TYPE             AS BuildingBlockType,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION                                 AS Dimension,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.DEFAULT_VALUE             AS DefaultValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSION   AS ParameterValueVersion,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.SPECIES                   AS Species,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILD_MODE                      AS BuildMode,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE                        AS Sequence,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DEFAULT_UNIT                              AS DefaultUnit,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.VALUE_ORIGIN              AS ValueOriginId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.IS_INPUT                        AS IsInput,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.is_changed_by_create_individual AS IsChangedByCreateIndividual

FROM TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS
         INNER JOIN (TAB_CONTAINERS INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES ON
        TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.PARAMETER_NAME) ON
        (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_NAME) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_TYPE) AND
        (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_ID = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_ID))
                    ON (TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_TYPE) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_ID = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_VALUES.CONTAINER_ID)
WHERE (((TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE) <> 'LINK' And
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE) <> 'APPLICATION'))
ORDER BY TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE;

CREATE VIEW [EventChangedParametersAbsolutePath]
AS
SELECT 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_ID] AS [Id], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_CONTAINER_TYPE] AS [Type], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_NAME] AS [Name], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[CALCULATION_METHOD] AS [CalculationMethod], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[FORMULA_RATE] AS [Rate], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[CONTAINER_ID] AS [ContainerId], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE] AS [ContainerType], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[CONTAINER_NAME] AS [ContainerName], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[PARAMETER_NAME] AS [RateObjectName], 
       0 AS [RelativeObjectPathId], 
       1 AS [IsAbsolutePath], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS].[USE_AS_VALUE] AS [UseAsValue], 
       0 AS [UseAmount]
FROM   [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS];
CREATE VIEW [EventChangedParametersRelativePath]
AS
SELECT 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_ID] AS [Id], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_CONTAINER_TYPE] AS [Type], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[EVENT_NAME] AS [Name], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[CALCULATION_METHOD] AS [CalculationMethod], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[FORMULA_RATE] AS [Rate], 
       0 AS [ContainerId], 
       [TAB_OBJECT_PATHS].[REF_CONTAINER_TYPE], 
       [TAB_OBJECT_PATHS].[REF_CONTAINER_NAME], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[PARAMETER_NAME] AS [RateObjectName], 
       [TAB_OBJECT_PATHS].[PATH_ID] AS [RelativeObjectPathId], 
       0 AS [IsAbsolutePath], 
       [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[USE_AS_VALUE] AS [UseAsValue], 
       0 AS [UseAmount]
FROM   [TAB_OBJECT_PATHS]
       INNER JOIN [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS] ON [TAB_OBJECT_PATHS].[PATH_ID] = [TAB_EVENT_CHANGED_GENERIC_PARAMETERS].[PATH_ID];

CREATE VIEW VIEW_PARAMETER_DISTRIBUTIONS AS
SELECT TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_ID              AS ContainerId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_TYPE            AS ContainerType,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_NAME            AS ContainerName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.PARAMETER_NAME            AS ParameterName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.MIN_VALUE                 AS MinValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.MIN_ISALLOWED             AS MinIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.MAX_VALUE                 AS MaxValue,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.MAX_ISALLOWED             AS MaxIsAllowed,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.READ_ONLY                       AS ReadOnly,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED                   AS CanBeVaried,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CAN_BE_VARIED_IN_POPULATION     AS CanBeVariedInPopulation,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.GROUP_NAME                      AS GroupName,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.PARAMETER_VALUE_VERSION   AS ParameterValueVersion,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.POPULATION                AS Population,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.GENDER                    AS Gender,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.AGE                       AS Age,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.GESTATIONAL_AGE           AS GestationalAge,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE         AS Distribution,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.MEAN_VALUE                AS Mean,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.STANDARD_DEVIATION        AS Deviation,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION                                 AS Dimension,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILDING_BLOCK_TYPE             AS BuildingBlockType,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.VISIBLE                         AS Visible,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.BUILD_MODE                      AS BuildMode,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE                        AS Sequence,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DEFAULT_UNIT                              AS DefaultUnit,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.VALUE_ORIGIN              AS ValueOriginId,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.IS_INPUT                        AS IsInput,
       TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.is_changed_by_create_individual AS IsChangedByCreateIndividual
FROM TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS
         INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES ON TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME =
                                                                                 TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.PARAMETER_NAME)
                    ON (TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.PARAMETER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_NAME = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_NAME) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_TYPE = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_TYPE) AND
                       (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.CONTAINER_ID = TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_ID)
WHERE (((TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_TYPE) <> 'LINK' And
        (TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.CONTAINER_TYPE) <> 'APPLICATION') AND
       ((TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETER_CURVES.PARAMETER_NAME) Not In
        ('Volume fraction lipids scale factor', 'Volume fraction proteins scale factor',
         'Volume fraction water scale factor')))
ORDER BY TAB_CONTAINER_PARAMETERS.SEQUENCE;
CREATE VIEW VIEW_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS AS
SELECT TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.MOLECULE AS MoleculeName,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME AS ParameterName,
       TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE AS Distribution,
       TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.MEAN_VALUE AS Mean,
       TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.STANDARD_DEVIATION AS Deviation,
       TAB_PARAMETERS.DIMENSION AS Dimension
FROM TAB_PROTEIN_NAMES INNER JOIN (TAB_PARAMETERS INNER JOIN TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS ON TAB_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME = TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.PARAMETER_NAME) ON TAB_PROTEIN_NAMES.PROTEIN = TAB_MOLECULE_PARAMETERS.MOLECULE;
CREATE VIEW [VIEW_INDIVIDUAL_PARAMETER_SAME_FORMULA_OR_VALUE_FOR_ALL_SPECIES]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
                [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_id] AS [ContainerId], 
                [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_type] AS [ContainerType], 
                [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_name] AS [ContainerName], 
                [tab_container_parameter_rates].[parameter_name] AS [ParameterName], 
                1 AS [IsSameFormula]
FROM   [tab_container_parameter_rates],
       [tab_species_calculation_methods],
       [tab_container_parameters]
WHERE  [tab_container_parameter_rates].[calculation_method] = [tab_species_calculation_methods].[calculation_method]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[container_id] = [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_id]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[container_type] = [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_type]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[container_name] = [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_name]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[parameter_name] = [tab_container_parameter_rates].[parameter_name]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[building_block_type] = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP  BY
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_id], 
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_type], 
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[container_name], 
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[parameter_name], 
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[calculation_method], 
          [tab_container_parameter_rates].[formula_rate]
HAVING COUNT ([tab_species_calculation_methods].[species]) = (SELECT COUNT ([species])
       FROM   [tab_species])
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT 
                [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_id] AS [ContainerId], 
                [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_type] AS [ContainerType], 
                [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_name] AS [ContainerName], 
                [tab_container_parameter_values].[parameter_name] AS [ParameterName], 
                0 AS [IsSameFormula]
FROM   [tab_container_parameters],
       [tab_container_parameter_values],
       [tab_species_parameter_value_versions]
WHERE  [tab_container_parameters].[container_id] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_id]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[container_type] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_type]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[container_name] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_name]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[parameter_name] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[parameter_name]
         AND [tab_species_parameter_value_versions].[species] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[species]
         AND [tab_species_parameter_value_versions].[parameter_value_version] = [tab_container_parameter_values].[parameter_value_version]
         AND [tab_container_parameters].[building_block_type] = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP  BY
          [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_id], 
          [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_type], 
          [tab_container_parameter_values].[container_name], 
          [tab_container_parameter_values].[parameter_name], 
          [tab_container_parameter_values].[default_value]
HAVING COUNT ([tab_container_parameter_values].[species]) = (SELECT COUNT ([species])
       FROM   [tab_species])
ORDER  BY
          [IsSameFormula],
          [ParameterName],
          [ContainerId];
CREATE VIEW [VIEW_INDIVIDUAL_PARAMETER_NOT_FOR_ALL_SPECIES]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
                [ContainerParameters_Species].[container_id] AS [ContainerId], 
                [ContainerParameters_Species].[container_type] AS [ContainerType], 
                [ContainerParameters_Species].[container_name] AS [ContainerName], 
                [ContainerParameters_Species].[parameter_name] AS [ParameterName], 
                COUNT ([ContainerParameters_Species].[species]) AS [SpeciesCount]
FROM   [ContainerParameters_Species]
GROUP  BY
          [container_id], 
          [container_type], 
          [container_name], 
          [parameter_name]
HAVING COUNT ([species]) < (SELECT COUNT ([species])
       FROM   [tab_species])
ORDER  BY
          [container_id],
          [parameter_name];
CREATE VIEW [ContainerParameters_Species]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
                [cpv].[container_id], 
                [cpv].[container_type], 
                [cpv].[container_name], 
                [cpv].[parameter_name], 
                [species]
FROM   [tab_container_parameter_values] AS [cpv],
       [tab_container_parameters] AS [cp]
WHERE  [cpv].[container_id] = [cp].[container_id]
         AND [cpv].[parameter_name] = [cp].[parameter_name]
         AND [building_block_type] = 'INDIVIDUAL'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT 
                [cpr].[container_id], 
                [cpr].[container_type], 
                [cpr].[container_name], 
                [cpr].[parameter_name], 
                [species]
FROM   [tab_container_parameter_rates] AS [cpr],
       [tab_species_calculation_methods] AS [scm],
       [tab_container_parameters] AS [cp]
WHERE  [cpr].[calculation_method] = [scm].[calculation_method]
         AND [cpr].[container_id] = [cp].[container_id]
         AND [cpr].[parameter_name] = [cp].[parameter_name]
         AND [building_block_type] = 'INDIVIDUAL';

CREATE VIEW [VIEW_MODEL_CONTAINERS]
AS
SELECT 
       [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[MODEL] AS [Model], 
       [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_ID] AS [Id], 
       [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE] AS [Type], 
       [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME] AS [Name], 
       [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[USAGE_IN_INDIVIDUAL] AS [UsageInIndividual], 
       [TAB_CONTAINERS].[PARENT_CONTAINER_ID] AS [ParentId]
FROM   ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES]
        INNER JOIN [TAB_CONTAINERS] ON ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[CONTAINER_NAME] = [TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME])
             AND ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[CONTAINER_TYPE] = [TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]))
       INNER JOIN [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS] ON ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME] = [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME])
            AND ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE] = [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE])
            AND ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_ID] = [TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_ID])
WHERE  (([TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]) <> 'PROCESS'
         AND ([TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]) <> 'APPLICATION'
         AND ([TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]) <> 'EVENT'
         AND ([TAB_MODEL_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]) <> 'EVENTGROUP')
ORDER  BY [TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[SEQUENCE];

AS

       [TAB_POPULATION_CONTAINERS].[POPULATION] AS [Population],

       [TAB_CONTAINERS].[PARENT_CONTAINER_ID] AS [ParentId]
FROM   ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES]
        INNER JOIN [TAB_CONTAINERS] ON ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[CONTAINER_NAME] = [TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME])
             AND ([TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[CONTAINER_TYPE] = [TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE]))
       INNER JOIN [TAB_POPULATION_CONTAINERS] ON ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME] = [TAB_POPULATION_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_NAME])
            AND ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE] = [TAB_POPULATION_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_TYPE])
            AND ([TAB_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_ID] = [TAB_POPULATION_CONTAINERS].[CONTAINER_ID])
ORDER  BY [TAB_CONTAINER_NAMES].[SEQUENCE];

CREATE VIEW VIEW_SCHEMA_ITEM_CONTAINERS AS SELECT  TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES.APPLICATION_TYPE AS ApplicationType, min(TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_ID) AS Id, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE AS Type, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME AS Name
FROM  (TAB_CONTAINERS JOIN TAB_APPLICATIONS ON TAB_APPLICATIONS.APPLICATION_NAME = TAB_CONTAINERS.PARENT_CONTAINER_NAME) JOIN TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES ON TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES.APPLICATION_TYPE = TAB_APPLICATIONS.APPLICATION_TYPE
GROUP BY TAB_APPLICATION_TYPES.APPLICATION_TYPE, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_TYPE, TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME
HAVING (TAB_CONTAINERS.CONTAINER_NAME='ProtocolSchemaItem');
COMMIT;
